item: Row J J1: the feed-key backfill owns its transaction only in true driver autocommit, so a caller's rollback takes the keys back
refs: R145; branch claude/v0-5-plan-j8zvre (PR number at push)
summary: The independent read found backfill_feed_keys decided from the driver's in_transaction flag, which pysqlite sets only at the first DML: a caller inside a SQLAlchemy engine.begin() that had only read looked idle, got a BEGIN IMMEDIATE...COMMIT of its own, and its later rollback no longer undid the keys. It now owns a transaction only when the driver is idle AND in true autocommit (isolation_level None or autocommit True); any other mode joins the caller's implicit transaction. Neither caller in src/ changed (both run in autocommit; the encrypted rebuild still measures 0.23 s at 6,400 sources). Two tests, red without.
